app_fee.value: The Harvard Griffin GSAS application fee is USD 105, paid by credit card only and not refundable; each application (up to three programs per year) needs its own fee.
app_fee.quote: The application fee is $105 payable by credit card. | The application fee is not refundable.

fee_waiver.value: You can check fee-waiver eligibility by answering questions in the Application Fee section of the online application, which gives an immediate answer; the page does not restrict waivers by citizenship.
fee_waiver.quote: Harvard Griffin GSAS is committed to ensuring that our fee does not create a financial obstacle. | Applicants can determine eligibility for a fee waiver by completing a series of questions in the Application Fee section of the application.

gre_general.value: Set by each program (Required, Optional or Not Accepted); see the program record.
gre_general.quote: Your degree program will note one of three options regarding submission of scores for the GRE General Test.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 5 on the new scale (95 for tests taken before January 21, 2026), with Speaking at least 4.5 (23 on the old scale); some programs set higher scores.
toefl_min.quote: Earning a minimum score of 5 (95 for tests taken prior to January 21, 2026) on the TOEFL iBT and a minimum Speaking score of 4.5 (23 for tests taken prior to January 21, 2026).

also.quote: Some degree programs may require higher scores on either the TOEFL or IELTS.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7 overall with Speaking at least 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: Earning a minimum score of 7 on the IELTS Academic test and a minimum Speaking score of 6.5.

english_waiver.value: No test is needed if your undergraduate degree is from an institution where English is the primary language of instruction; a master's or other graduate degree does not count.
english_waiver.quote: Receiving an undergraduate degree from an academic institution where English is the primary language of instruction. | A master’s degree or other graduate degree is not accepted as proof of English proficiency.

notes: All PhD applications go through Harvard Kenneth C. Griffin GSAS. Up to three applications to different programs per year, each with its own fee. TOEFL/IELTS scores must be from tests taken no earlier than January 5, 2025 for fall 2027.
